english.title: Attempt to cause / incite a child 13 - 17 to become a prostitution / be involved in pornography
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally attempted to cause or incite a child aged

(A)_[13]_
(B)_[14]_
(C)_[15]_
(D)_[16]_
(E)_[17]_

and whom you did not reasonably believe was aged 18 or over

(F)_[to become a prostitute]_
(G)_[to be involved in pornography]_

in any part of the world
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 72 of, and Schedule 2 to, the Sexual Offences Act 2003 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by UK nationals / residents.

This offence document is OBSOLETE from 3rd May 2015 - for offences committed on or after this date CJS code SX03230A (H12222) should be used.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Fourteen years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
